summary: Rand Paul, an ophthalmologist and son of Ron Paul, has been a Republican senator from Kentucky since 2011 and ran for president in 2016. A libertarian-leaning conservative, he chairs the Homeland Security Committee; his former staff include Sergio Gor and Rachel Bovard, and Jeff Yass funded his 2016 run.
